content.title: Birch Hill, Brookfield to acquire Canada's First National Financial for C$2.9 billion
content.summary: (Reuters) -First National Financial said on Sunday it has reached an agreement to be acquired by private equity firm Birch Hill Equity Partners and asset manager Brookfield Asset Management in a deal valuing the company's equity at C$2.9 billion  ($2.12 billion).  First National said that Birch Hill and Brookfield will buy its shares for C$48 each in cash.  Founders Stephen Smith and Moray Tawse will each sell two-thirds of their current shareholding in the company.
